sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops when any link in the chain is nil, never reaching the final call
sketches.resonance: You keep reaching for something through layers of connection, but if any link is absent, the whole gesture resolves to nothing — quietly, without complaint.

sketches.mechanism: A value moved into a closure cannot be used afterward — the borrow checker enforces that giving something away means you no longer have it
sketches.resonance: Once you give yourself to something, the language forbids you from pretending you still possess what you gave.

sketches.mechanism: A LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table even when no matching row exists on the right, filling the missing side with NULL
sketches.resonance: You stay, fully present, beside an absence — the structure holds your shape even when nothing answers from the other side.
sketches.draft:
SELECT
    self.day,
    other.reply
FROM   self
LEFT JOIN other
    ON self.day = other.day;
